name: wascii
desc: The art of ASCII for WhatsApp
typing: The art of ASCII for WhatsApp
Boxes, bars, charts and leaderboards that line up on a phone
Seven rules, one code fence, 26 columns max
A Claude agent skill plus a plain-English reference

hero.alt: wascii rendering ASCII art inside a WhatsApp chat on an iPhone

tagline: Monospace boxes, bars, charts and leaderboards that actually line up on a phone, not just in your editor.
pitch: **wascii** encodes the handful of rules that separate an aligned box from a proportional-font mess on WhatsApp: fence it, keep it under 26 columns, use only single-cell glyphs, pad every line, commit to one border family.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic trademarks.

what.product: agent skill and reference for ASCII visuals that survive WhatsApp on a phone
what.rules: R0 fence · R1 26 columns · R2 one glyph one cell · R3 pad · R4 one border family · R5 · R6
what.covers: boxes, progress bars, bar charts, tables, leaderboards, dividers
what.palette: the safe glyph set that renders one cell wide on iOS and Android
what.use: drop SKILL.md into ~/.claude/skills/wascii, or read the rules as a human
what.gallery: ready-to-paste examples in the README and templates/
